locator.text: Display 141.4, p. 141, in the proof of Lemma A.8

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. The right-hand equality ∫_0^∞ (U^2 - E^2/2) dX = 0 is stated verbatim: `totalS`/`energyDensity` are exactly that integrand and integral over `Ioi 0`, and `energy_zero` asserts it vanishes. The left-hand equality — the physical radial moment ∫_0^∞ r (u_z^2 + p) dr and its conversion to the similarity integral by the factor q^{1-2A} — was not found as a declaration or as a step: searching the index and the Lemma A.8 chain turned up no integral of a physical pressure or axial velocity over the physical radius in this file group. Lean instead keeps the q-powers pointwise (`physicalPressure_eq_terminal` gives p = q^{-2A}Π, and the same bridge carries u_z = q^{-A}U) and obtains the vanishing it needs for the stress limits from `HeatTailHistoryLimits.energyHistory_tendsto_zero` (S(∞) = 0) together with X·Π → 0, used in `TerminalHistoryBridge.axialWeight_tendsto_zero`. So the same conclusion is reached by a route that never forms the physical moment; the prefactor q^{1-2A} as written is not checked anywhere I found. The surrounding result is still proved, hence low.
